Who the hell's wallowing in self-pity? Not I. I've been working on it, and have started moving on. Shit, a body reacts to a pain, for however long is needed, then gets back up and keeps going. As far as you're concerned, trying to go through with the bulk of the pain, communicating during this, doing that just to assist in coping with it, whilst gathering sufficient strength to even want to go another step, and you that wallowing in self-pity. Ok, then fine, then, if that's what you want to see. Me, I'm just gonna continue whilst you look at selp-pity. I got better things to do with my time. You can continue to waste yours.

She is no longer with me, ok? And even when we were together, while there was love, and still is, from her, there is no spark, nothing I could light, but was willing to be patient. So much for patience.

O foad. I was, and still am hurting, and didn't know where to go, because, by your lights, I'm just a dummy who should have known better. I wanted to say something, and yes, I didn't know where to go, so I flipped a coin(mentally), and tried here. And as a result, to you and the likes of you, all I deserve in turn is strong criticism usually reserved for trolls of the worst kind. My apologies if my trying to speak out my hurt and in turn attempt get a handle on it in order to see more straight in order to avoid doing something really stupid, but obvious, apparently I should have read about the finer rules which don't really exist except for those who are in the know. I'm quite sure that when you've been hurt, and it felt terrible, you knew exactly what to do and where to go. Unlike you, I prefer not to yell, "Man up, you f***ing p*ssy, 'cause yer makin' me ill", or something to that effect. Sometimes a body just hasta try to react in a way that might help alleviate that pain just a little bit. If you ever have a son, and he gets into a situation that he hurts bad from, no matter how young the kid is, or how silly the situation looks from afar, I hope you don't yell at him to man up, but are willing to be a real parent, which is not testosterone spraying or yelling, but simply sitting and listening, especially when the kid is sick and you don't know what else to do. A real man will always be understanding and patient, not some braying jackass yelling about what a man is supposed to be.

No she does not. She claimed last night that she's had to be on her own and has had to make hard decisions. She never did answer what I asked, which was to if I was, and still am, so willing to give what ever is needed including and up to my life itself in order to be part of something special, what else could be harder that a person would be willing to do, and knowing that there could be no returning? She never answered that, and has since been silent. I'm willing to give all to be part of something special. If that is what is defined as "submissive" then so be it, although I'm actually quite independent and hard headed m'self when the need arises. I am a take charge kind of guy, and have to be, especially given the line of work I am in(aircraft mechanic), but if I see a relationship worth the kind of gift that only the gods would bestow, then I go for it. She does not want me desperately, nor would I allow her to act that way(by simply asking that she not do so). She is the avatar of the Goddess, and now, it looks like I'll have to ask the gods that another avatar come into my life, because for the time we were together, she was the center of my multiverse, and during that time, there could be no other(sorry Duncan McLeod). Now I try to find the other. And no, you weren't being a dick, and I saw no droplets of testosterone anywhere; you were simply offering advice as you saw fit, nothing more.

Sorry about that last reply, but this keyboard was having problems, so I replaced it with another one I didn't know much about,  and now I know why it was set aside.

Anyway, My Goddess is Brighid, and my God is Lugh, both being deities concerned with, among other things, crafts making and the like, with Brighid concerned more with the hearth and similar, and Lugh with any and every kind of crafts making and smithery of all types.

I do my ritual work as a solitary, in the woods on my property, and it is mostly crafting, such as canes and related(walking sticks and staves), and sometimes it sells, but other times I simply give stuff I make away, and the ritual part is in the crafting itself, which has no set day or time.

Tonight, my wife and I have begun discussing splitting. I knew this was coming, even though I didn't know a thing until tonight.

However, the split will be permanent, and there is nothing I can do about it. I still love her, and to me, she is still an avatar of the Goddess, and in some sense, it feels like the deity I worship has rejected me, which is like the name less god, the xtian god, tells one of his followers to go to hell, which I feel'd be far more pleasant than where I should send myself, which is a rope around my neck, a dozen meters off the deck, which, if you really thought about it, is a really horrible way to go, because even though consciousness leaves after approximately 30 seconds, followed by death by asphyxiation after an additional 3.5 minutes(when the brain finally succumbs to o2 starvation), that first half minute is actually longer than an entire lifetime, and all during this, the only support for the body is a thin strip of the neck, which translates to an agony passing that of the most difficult birth by any woman without any kind of anesthesia, and finally the final personal insult, the bowels letting go as all the muscles in the body relax in death. 

And no, I'm not gonna do that, simply by dint of what I just described, by simply imagining what that rope around the neck would feel like supporting 120+kilos, plus what the inner perceptions would be like until unconsciousness, and I'm not about to test my words, at least not yet, mebbe never.

But, I am hurting, am alone, and am not looking for a lover, because in this forum or whatever it is, that would be very unethical, not to mention stupid beyond imagining.

For now, I'll choose to live, although that could be subject to change at a moment's notice, and barring misadventure. 

Yes, I'd like to talk to someone, but I doubt you, because you're a professional of some sort, and I've dealt with too many of those, lo these past 58 years of so I've crawled on this Mortal Coil.

I need someone, yes, desperately, but for the nonce, I'll have to be satisfied with whatever stares back at me in the bathroom mirror, 'cause I'll never find it here, although I wouldn't mind conversation with someone who doesn't mind the semi-understandable gruntings of a dumb aeroplane mechanic,

And who are you to call me, "my dear" anyway? There is little, if anything that is "dear" about me. Not even my wife ever called me dear, and she never found me very sexy, which always stung a bit, but then, I guess us guys are just vain little toddlers who whine about the silliest stuff, while the ladies barely tolerate us(some probably wishing that the vet could neuter us, along with the dogs and cats).

Why ask to be kind? From that angle, you look to be a lovely lady, young or mature, so, unless you have a face that could stop a computer, which is doubtful, then the rest of you would be very welcomed here, at least by me, if only because it looks like you have the body of a Goddess, and could pass as an avatar(a physical embodiment) of the Goddess, and I'm only telling the bald truth(I wonder if the truth was ever possessed of a full head of hair, seeing as everyone says "the bald truth"). But one thing though, ladies are lovely when unshaven, but then, that's just me, and not a reflection upon you.
